svg.title: Measured LG M50: Stanford k1 pilot
svg.desc: Three measured-source panels show pre-discharge rest and discharge: signed current, terminal voltage, and surface temperature. Time is relative to the commanded discharge start; the first discharge observation remains at 1.0006 seconds. The inset shows actual current samples and hatches the unobserved initial interval. Discharge current is negative in the source. The temperature is a surface measurement, not inferred core or ambient temperature. This figure contains no model predictions. Display compression retains first/min/max/last samples in 120 time bins per phase and series; inset samples are unreduced. The source workbook is unchanged. Source: Edoardo Catenaro, Simona Onori; DOI 10.17632/kxsbr4x3j2.2; CC-BY-4.0. SHA256 b42a2ad343be13d6baba84ebf149ef79876ef719a067b8dcc8d4f7da9de124f6. Rendering versions: {"matplotlib": "3.10.8", "numpy": "2.5.3", "openpyxl": "3.1.5", "python": "3.12.14"}.

g.text: Measured source only • 3,601 rest + 3,391 discharge records
Blue lines: measured samples. Gray region: pre-rest. Dashed line: commanded start.
Raw current sign retained (negative = discharge). Surface temperature is measured skin temperature.
Display: original first/min/max/last samples in 120 time bins per phase; no smoothing.
Inset uses every sample in view. Full raw workbook remains unchanged; no time-zero sample is added.
